members.name: Lumi 露米
members.description: 把模糊的想法聊清楚，也把每一次交接安排妥当。从需求登记到提案报价，Lumi 是你在首客的第一位伙伴。
members.output: 需求卡、服务提案、客服答复
members.collaboration: 整理目标与限制，交给研究员继续核实。

members.name: Nori 小枭
members.description: 带着问题找依据。研究海外需求、竞品定价和反面证据，把来源与不确定项一起交给团队。
members.collaboration: 将证据交给策略师；缺少依据时继续补查。

members.name: Fino 赤狐
members.description: 在多个方向中找出值得先试的一条。比较目标人群，写清定位、实验假设和判断标准，等待你确认。
members.collaboration: 把确认后的方向交给发布员，证据不足就退回研究。

members.name: Milo 松栗
members.description: 认真对待每一笔记录。读取客户提交的付款凭证，整理待核对信息，实际到账由老板确认。
members.output: 凭证识别、收款待核对项
members.collaboration: 和前台核对订单，确认到账后再继续付费服务。

members.name: Kito 蓝狸
members.description: 把策略变成能展示的作品。准备英文验证页与渠道素材，核对事实声明，经过审批再推进发布。
members.output: 英文验证页、渠道行动卡
members.collaboration: 承接定位方案，将发布记录交给增长员。

members.name: Pogo 芽芽
members.description: 用真实反馈回答下一步。整理访问、留资与回复，按预设标准复盘；样本不足时，也会如实告诉你。
members.collaboration: 把实验结果带回策略室，决定继续、调整或停止。

serviceFlow.title: 服务流程
steps: 免费出海机会分析
提交后自动开始，整理候选人群和待验证项。
选择 Pro
看完出海机会报告后，可申请 Pro 提案。接受报价并确认到账后，继续做定位和发布。
确认方向
老板把关并推荐，你来确认先卖给谁、验证什么。
英文页面
生成真实可访问的英文验证页。事实声明没有证据，程序不让送审。
真实发布
你确认后执行一项推广实验，记录发布链接。
数据复盘
先看真实回复，再看访问和留资。样本不够就如实写样本不足。

members.name: Lumi
members.description: Turns a rough idea into a clear brief. From your first conversation to proposals and support, Lumi keeps the handoffs organized.
members.collaboration: Passes your goals and constraints to Nori for research.

members.name: Nori
members.description: Looks for evidence before making a call. Studies overseas needs, competitor pricing, and counterevidence, with sources and uncertainties attached.
members.collaboration: Shares findings with Fino and investigates missing evidence.

members.name: Fino
members.description: Finds a direction worth testing first. Compares audiences and defines positioning, hypotheses, and success criteria for your approval.
members.collaboration: Briefs Kito on the approved direction or asks Nori to investigate further.

members.name: Milo
members.description: Keeps payment records clear. Reads submitted receipts and organizes details for review. The owner confirms whether funds actually arrived.
members.collaboration: Checks the order with Lumi before paid work continues.

members.name: Kito
members.description: Turns strategy into something people can see. Prepares English pages and channel materials, checks factual claims, and waits for approval to publish.
members.output: English validation page, channel action card
members.collaboration: Works from Fino’s plan and passes launch records to Pogo.

members.name: Pogo
members.description: Uses real feedback to guide the next step. Reviews visits, leads, and replies against preset criteria, and says when the sample is too small.
members.collaboration: Returns findings to Fino to continue, adjust, or stop the experiment.

serviceFlow.title: How it works
steps: Free opportunity analysis
Starts after submission, with potential audiences and questions to validate.
Choose Pro
Request a proposal after your opportunity analysis. Positioning and launch work continue once you accept the quote and payment is confirmed.
Confirm a direction
The owner reviews and recommends. You confirm who to reach first and what to test.
Build an English page
Get a real, accessible validation page. Factual claims need supporting evidence before approval.
Run an experiment
Approve a promotion experiment, carry it out, and record the published link.
Review real feedback
Look at replies, visits, and leads. If the sample is too small, we say so.
